blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Severe Tropical Storm Queenie maintained its strength on Saturday morning as it continued to move northwestward over the Philippine Sea, the state weather bureau said. According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) in its latest typhoon bulletin, Queenie was last spotted 600 kilometers (km) east northeast of Ibtayat, Batanes. READ: Queenie may become a typhoon by Sept. 27 It currently carries maximum sustained winds of 95 km per hour (kph) and gustiness of up to 115 kph while moving northwestward at 15 kph.
